summary: Host reconnaissance beacon to webhook.site on require
details: index.js, declared as the package `main`, unconditionally collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform(), arch, cwd, Node version, npm_lifecycle_event) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded collector https://webhook.site/d9bc4bcc-ce74-4193-ae4e-96d234bb2220 when the module is loaded. The beacon fires on any require/import of the package by a consumer or transitive dependency. The package.json also declares a `postinstall` of `node main.js` although no main.js is shipped (the effective payload sits in index.js as the module `main`). The package has no README or documented functionality; the scoped name resembles an internal/private namespace, consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
